name: weak-android
notes: Default gate: approximates a low-end Android phone on desktop Chromium. cpu_throttle_rate=4 means every JS operation costs 4x, so 24 fps under throttle corresponds to roughly 60 fps on the real device. founder-spec RAM ceiling: 750 MB for the whole browser process tree. LOOSENED 2026-11-04 (founder decision): load/FCP budgets raised 3x while first real-generation diagnostics are collected - no generated page has been measured under the tight numbers yet, and the perf gate must not mask the pipeline's real timing story. Tighten back toward the repo budget (load < 2s) at the Phase 4 frontend pass with measured data in hand. fps/RAM stay at founder spec.
